title: ARVINMERITOR AUTOMOTIVE: SUSPENSION:TWIN I-BEAM:FRONT SPINDLE:KNUCKLE STEER (28,845 affected)
summary: FRONT AXLE BEAMS CONTAIN "SHEAR CRACKS" AT THE BEAM ENDS  WHERE THE KING PINS AND STEERING KNUCKLES ARE ATTACHED.                                                                                                           CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: IF FAILURE OF THE AXLE BEAMS AS PART OF THE FRONT         STEERING AXLE SHOULD OCCUR, THE COMPONENTS ATTACHED TO THE BEAMS INCLUDING       WHEELS, TIRES, BRAKE ASSEMBLIES AND STEERING KNUCKLES MAY BECOME DISENGAGED      FROM THE VEHICLE, AND ROLL FREE WITH A RISK TO TRAFFIC SAFETY. THE VEHICLE MAY   LOSE STEERING CONTROL, CAUSING VEHICLE INSTABILITY AND POTENTIAL FOR VEHICLE     CRASH. THIS FAILURE COULD OCCUR WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING TO THE OPERATOR.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS (11,900 affected)
summary: IMPURE LUBRICATING GREASE USED IN THE HEADLIGHT SWITCHES  COULD CONTAMINATE ONE OR MORE CONTACT POINTS. OPERATION OF THE HEADLIGHTS COULD  BE DELAYED OR NOT LIGHT WHEN THE SWITCH IS TURNED ON OR WHEN THE DIMMER SWITCH   IS OPERATED.                                                                                                                                                      CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: LOSS OF HEAD LIGHTS WHILE DRIVING COULD RESULT IN A       VEHICLE ACCIDENT.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION (383 affected)
summary: LOOSENESS MAY DEVELOP AT THE ATTACHMENT (BALL JOINT) OF   THE DRAG LINK TO THE STEERING ARM DUE TO AN INSUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED RETAINING   NUT. THIS CAN WEAR THE STEERING ARM HOLE.                                                                                                                         CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: STEERING LOOSENESS COULD CAUSE HANDLING DIFFICULTY WHICH  MAY RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL:LINKAGES(12:83) (5,916 affected)
summary: METAL BUSHINGS FOR THE CRUISE CONTROL LINKAGE ARE         SUBJECT TO CORROSION DUE TO WEATHER CONDITIONS. ALSO, THERE IS NOT ENOUGH        CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE BUSHINGS AND THE SHAFT; AND THE LINKAGE POINTS WERE NOT    LUBRICATED. THUS, CRUISE CONTROL LINKAGE CAN BIND, CAUSING THE ACCELERATOR       PEDAL TO STICK IN A DEPRESSED POSITION.                                                                                                                           CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: THE VEHICLE, WITHOUT WARNING, WOULD CONTINUE AT SET       SPEED AND CAN'T BE REDUCED. THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN          ACCIDENT.

title: General Motors, LLC: STEERING:UNKNOWN TYPE:GEAR BOX (48 affected)
summary: ONE OF THE THREE STEERING GEAR TO FRAME BOLTS MAY NOT     HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED TO THE REQUIRED SPECIFICATION.                                                                                                                CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: THE STEERING GEAR COULD COME LOOSE FROM THE FRAME         CAUSING A LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND A POSSIBLE VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT          WARNING.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER (3,508 affected)
summary: BRAKE MASTER CYLINDERS MAY HAVE IMPROPERLY ANODIZED       INTERNAL SURFACES CAUSING ACCELERATED WEAR OF A PISTON SEAL.                                                                                                      CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: ONE PORTION OF THE SPLIT BRAKE SYSTEM WOULD BECOME        INEFFECTIVE RESULTING IN INCREASED STOPPING DISTANCE WHICH MAY CAUSE AN          ACCIDENT. DRIVER WOULD BE WARNED BY INCREASED PEDAL TRAVEL AND THE BRAKE         WARNING LIGHT.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WHEELS:RIM BASE (6,285 affected)
summary: THE STEEL WHEEL RIMS MAY CRACK AND BREAK.                                                                                                  CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: BROKEN WHEEL RIMS COULD CAUSE THE DRIVER TO LOSE CONTROL  OF THE VEHICLE AND RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.

title: MALONE AND HYDA, INC.: LIGHTING:FLASHER:TURN SIGNAL (106,969 affected)
summary: FAILURE OF FLASHER TO MEET DURABILITY, FLASH RATE AND     CURRENT REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108.                                                                                                                            CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: FAILURE TO PROPERLY SIGNAL DIRECTION OF VEHICLE TO        TRAFFIC. THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.                                                                                                                        CORRECTIVE ACTION REPLACEMENT OR REFUND OF PURCHASE PRICE UPON RETURN OF THE     FLASHER UNIT.

title: PERRIS VALLEY CAMPERS: WHEELS (12 affected)
summary: INCORRECT REAR DUAL WHEELS MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED,       MAKING THE WHEELS SUBJECT TO CRACK.                                                                                                                               CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: CONTINUED USE OF THESE WHEELS COULD CAUSE SERIOUS DAMAGE  AND POSSIBLY AN ACCIDENT.

title: FIRESTONE STEEL PROD. CO.: WHEELS:DISC:SPIDER (125 affected)
summary: DISCS WHICH HAD PREVIOUSLY BEEN STAMPED WITH PART NUMBER  27125 FOR USE WITH WHEELS HAVING THAT PART NUMBER WERE WELDED TO RIMS FOR        WHEELS HAVING PART NUMBER 27123. THE DISCS USED IN BOTH WHEEL ASSEMBLIES ARE     IDENTICAL, THE RESULTING PART THEREFORE IS STRUCTURALLY CORRECT. HOWEVER, THE    27126 WHEEL USES A 20X7.0 CR 5 DEGREE BEADSEAT RIM AND THE 27123 WHEEL USES A    20X6.5 5 DEGREE BEADSEAT RIM. A DIFFERENT SIZE TIRE IS USED WITH EACH OF THESE   RIMS.                                                                                                                                                             CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: IT WOULD BE POSSIBLE TO ASSEMBLE AN IMPROPER TIRE/WHEEL   COMBINATION. RESULTS OF THIS COULD BE OVERHEATING AND/OR TIRE CONTACT WHERE      USED AS DUALS. IF THIS OCCURS THE TIRE MAY FAIL AND LOSS OF CONTROL MAY BE       EXPERIENCED.

title: General Motors, LLC: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME (112 affected)
summary: THE TIRE PLACARD LABEL ON THE LEFT FRONT DOOR MAY HAVE    BEEN PRINTED WITH AN ERROR WHICH SPECIFIES A HIGHER MAXIMUM LOADING THAN IS      ALLOWED.                                                                                                                                                          CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: EXCESSIVE VEHICLE LOADING COULD CAUSE A TIRE BLOWOUT AND  RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.

title: General Motors, LLC: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL (47,081 affected)
summary: THE CRUISE CONTROL VACUUM SOLENOID VALVES MAY             MALFUNCTION AT ANY TIME THE ENGINE IS RUNNING AND THE CRUISE CONTROL IS ENGAGED  AND CAUSE UNEXPECTED ENGINE ACCELERATION.                                                                                                                         CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: LOSS OF ACCELERATOR CONTROL COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE     CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.

title: Trailmobile Canada Limited: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (568 affected)
summary: THE AIR BRAKE HOSE LEADING TO THE FRONT AXLE SPRING       BRAKE CHAMBERS MAY BE 1.5 INCHES SHORTER THAN THE SPECIFIED LENGTH OR ARE        CONNECTED TO AIR TANKS MISLOCATED UP TO 1.5 INCHES.                                                                                                               CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: FAILURE OF THE HOSES WOULD LEAD TO DECREASED BRAKING      CAPABILITY WHICH MAY RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS (21,000 affected)
summary: FRONT SEAT BELT RETRACTORS MAY NOT PROPERLY LOCK DURING   SUDDEN HEAVY BRAKE APPLICATION OR IMPACT DUE TO THE INTERFERENCE OF TWO          POSITIONING TABS.                                                                                                                                                 CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: THE SEAT BELT WOULD NOT RETAIN THE DRIVER OR PASSENGER    SUBJECTING THEM TO POSSIBLE INJURY IN CASE OF AN ACCIDENT.

title: NEOPLAN USA CORPORATION: SUSPENSION (1,800 affected)
summary: HAIRLINE CRACKS MAY OCCUR IN ONE OR MORE OF THREE WELD    AREAS: FRONT SUSPENSION INTERFACE PLATE AT THE BOTTOM FRAME STRUCTURE, REAR      SUSPENSION TERMINATION POINTS OF THE TRANSVERSE LINK TOWER OUTBOARD GUSSET, OR   REAR AXLE MOUNTING PAD TO THE A FRAME ON THE LONGITUDINAL BEAM.                                                                                                   CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: DRIVER MAY EXPERIENCE HANDLING DIFFICULTIES WHICH MAY     RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.

title: BLAZER INTERNATIONAL CORP: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:TAIL LIGHTS (20,000 affected)
summary: FILAMENTS ARE WIRED BACKWARD SO THAT LIGHT FROM           CONTINUOUSLY ILLUMINATED TAIL LAMPS HIDES THE LIGHT FROM INTERMITTENT STOP LAMP  SIGNAL.                                                                                                                                                           CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: FAILURE TO PROPERLY SIGNAL TRAFFIC WHICH COULD RESULT IN  A VEHICLE CRASH.

title: NEOPLAN USA CORPORATION: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING (2,000 affected)
summary: CIRCUIT BREAKERS ARE NOT AT SUFFICIENT RATINGS TO         PROTECT HIGH SIDE TOLERANCES, SOME WIRING HARNESSES ARE NOT ADEQUATELY SECURED   TO PREVENT CHAFING AND NO PROVISIONS WERE MADE FOR COMPLETE DISCONNECTION OF     ALL ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS IN CASE OF AN ELECTRICAL SHORT.                                                                                                            CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: THE ABOVE COULD RESULT IN A BUS FIRE.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES FITTINGS:METALLIC (121,095 affected)
summary: THE FUEL SYSTEM MAY LEAK AT THE THROTTLE BODY INJECTION   FUEL FEED PIPE CONNECTION.                                                                                                                                        CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: THIS LEAKAGE COULD RESULT IN AN UNDERHOOD FIRE WHICH      COULD SPREAD TO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT AND CAUSE BURN INJURIES TO OCCUPANTS.
